items.q: Feather and Barry Ulanov, who was fixing Leonard's coattails, so to speak

ctx.x: This is the hateful thing that it's hard to forgive, that these few handful of writers, starting with Leonard
Feather and Barry Ulanov, who was fixing Leonard's coattails, so to speak, and then a few more that followed in their footsteps because they seemed like winners. And this is what--
They seemed to -- Leonard particularly seemed to vent his spleen on you, as sort of symbolic of everything that they called the moldy figs.
